author: felipeblassioli
abstract: Pause the task and review the collaboration itself. Finds recurring friction between what the user asks, what the agent tends to do, and the durable guidance behind it (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, skills, ADRs, memories, templates), names the actual source of each pattern, challenges stale or over-broad guidance subtraction-first, and challenges the user too. Ends with at most five concrete changes and one cheap experiment; edits nothing unless asked.
